messages:
alex: Quick heads up — planning a staggered v2 slow-push tomorrow 09:00 PT. Hold at 1% traffic for first 30m, then step to 10% if metrics look good.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled by alex for 2026-05-01 09:00 PT. Canaries: 5 pods. @oncall will get alerts. :rocket:

mira: Which clients are at risk here? Any schema changes we should call out in release notes?

luis: Mobile SDKs <= 1.4 fail on our new default response_format (now returns structured chunks). Preflight showed 422 and parse errors in 1.2/1.3.

sam: Ah — that's the pattern we saw in integration tests. Can we gate by header so old SDKs keep v1 behavior?

alex: Yes. Plan: add X-API-Fallback: v1 routing header for traffic from clients with header X-Client-Version <=1.4. Rollout steps:
- Step 0: deploy with feature flag off
- Step 1 (09:00): enable 1% traffic to v2
- Step 2 (09:30): bump to 10% if no regressions
- Step 3 (rolling): 25/50 then full.

Rollback criteria (explicit):
- error rate > 1% above baseline for 15m OR
- parsing errors > 0.5% for mobile cohort OR
- p95 latency increase > 50% for 15m
If triggered -> immediate traffic pin to v1 and rollback to previous v2 image.

ops-oncall: I'll add monitors and a handoff note in the runbook. Link once created.

luis: Quick test snippet to simulate old client:
```
curl -H 'X-Client-Version: 1.3' -H 'X-API-Fallback: v1' -d 'input=hi' https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate
```
Log excerpt from staging:
```
2026-04-28T14:22:01Z mobile-parser error parse_fail sdk=1.3 payload=... status=422
```

sam: I'll update release notes to call out header workaround and SDK upgrade guidance. Also add the 'how to pin' section for partners.

alex: OK. Action items:
- luis: confirm header routing working end-to-end by 08:30 PT
- ops-oncall: create monitors + runbook links
- sam: update release notes and internal quickstart
- mira: coordinate with growth/partners for the partner email
I'll flip the slow-push flag at 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canaries started 09:00:15 PT — routing 1% to v2. Canary IDs: c-42..c-46.

mira: Noted. If partners ask about ETA, tell them a cautious ramp over next 2-3 hours.

alex: We'll reconvene at 09:45 PT for go/no-go on 10% bump. If anything odd, call for immediate rollback.

sam: ack. I'll post release notes link once live.
